description.value: Massawa Restaurant is an Ethiopian and Eritrean restaurant established in 2021 in New Westminster, serving traditional dishes such as doro wat, injera firfir, awaze tibs, and kitfo, all presented on injera made fresh daily from teff. The kitchen is halal-certified, fully licensed, and offers an extensive vegetarian and vegan menu alongside gluten-free options. Free Wi-Fi, takeout, and delivery make it a practical and flavorful stop for cyclists touring the Lower Mainland.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 45m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM name, phone, and address. Key amenity evidence comes from the website: 'Free WiFi' confirmed on both the front page and contact page; 'Takeout & delivery available' and 'Vegetarian & vegan-friendly' confirmed on the about page; gluten-free injera confirmed on the menu page ('All dishes served with injera (100% gluten-free teff)'). No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
